name: minimax-h3-single-dancer-prompt
title_zh: MiniMax H3 单舞者提示词生成器：照片进
tagline_zh: 不用背英文参数，不用翻文档。贴图后一次问清舞蹈、时长、运镜、配乐、结尾，你回一串逗号分隔的数字。
tagline_en: No English params, no docs. Paste a photo, answer 6 choice groups in Chinese, get a runnable MiniMax H3.
desc_en: After a dancer image is attached, present all dance, duration, performance, camera, audio, and ending options in one Chinese selection message, then convert one comma-separated reply into a complete English MiniMax H3 single-dancer prompt. Use for one visible dancer; do not use for group choreography or generating the video itself.
why_zh: 把提示词工程拆成选择题，每个选项都对应 H3 实际支持的语法，避免你凭感觉写出的词被模型忽略或报错。
why_en: Turns prompt engineering into multiple-choice questions, each mapped to H3's actual grammar—so you don't guess words the model.
limit_zh: 只服务单人可见舞者；群舞、多人交互、或需要直接生成视频本体（它只出提示词）都不管。图片必须已附加，否则无从谈起。
limit_en: Single visible dancer only; no group choreography, no video generation (prompt only). Requires an attached dancer image to start.
title_en: Single-dancer MiniMax H3 prompt builder: photo in, full.
